sample_selection: 200 evenly spaced samples; identical across methods

online_timing.end_to_end: live audio decode/preprocess/CLAP audio encoding + method-specific scoring and ranking
online_timing.knowledge_stage: starts from current audio embedding; includes all method-specific matching, selection, fusion and ranking

fairness: all methods for a dataset use the same isolated physical GPU
different datasets may run concurrently on separate GPUs
deterministic seed reset from each immutable audio-batch identity before live CLAP encoding
CUDA synchronization around every timed segment
Top-1 agreement across live re-encoding repeats must be at least 99.5%; complete ranking hashes are retained as an audit because near-tied low-ranked classes can exchange order
accuracy_source: Task25 full-dataset metrics; timing subset is not used to re-estimate headline accuracy
